controls.input_condition: An installation is treated as an HSE during the 2026 to 2030 allocation period
controls.expected_action: Require inclusion in the published 2026 to 2030 HSE list before applying HSE-specific rules
controls.risk_prevented: Applying simplified HSE treatment to an unlisted installation

controls.input_condition: The installation claims HSE status because it primarily serves hospitals
controls.expected_action: Require at least 85% of the heat produced in the scheme year to be used by or supplied to one or more hospitals
controls.risk_prevented: Classifying incidental hospital heat supply as primary hospital service

controls.input_condition: The installation claims HSE status as a small emitter rather than as a hospital service provider
controls.expected_action: Require annual emissions below 25,000 tCO2e and, where combustion applies, total rated thermal input below 35 MW
controls.risk_prevented: Using only one of the two eligibility thresholds

controls.input_condition: An installation has valid HSE status for the scheme year
controls.expected_action: Do not create a main-scheme allowance-surrender obligation; assess compliance against its annual emissions target
controls.risk_prevented: Applying the wrong compliance mechanism

controls.input_condition: An installation has valid HSE status
controls.expected_action: Do not assign free allocation while HSE status applies
controls.risk_prevented: Giving free allowances to an excluded HSE installation

controls.input_condition: An installation is an HSE for a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Require an annual reportable-emissions target in the HSE permit
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving the HSE without a measurable compliance ceiling

controls.input_condition: The regulator sets ordinary HSE targets using a complete historic baseline
controls.expected_action: Base targets on historic emissions multiplied by the applicable annual reduction factor
controls.risk_prevented: Using an unadjusted historical average

controls.input_condition: The installation lacks a complete year of emissions data when HSE targets are first set
controls.expected_action: Use forecast emissions for the initial target and recalculate remaining-period targets when a full year becomes available
controls.risk_prevented: Treating an estimate as the permanent multi-year baseline

controls.input_condition: An HSE annual report is being prepared
controls.expected_action: Use 1 January through 31 December as the scheme-year monitoring period
controls.risk_prevented: Mixing allocation-period boundaries with annual reporting boundaries

controls.input_condition: The HSE scheme year has ended
controls.expected_action: Submit the previous year's annual emissions report through METS by 31 March
controls.risk_prevented: Late annual reporting

controls.input_condition: An HSE chooses its annual assurance route
controls.expected_action: Require either satisfactory independent verification or an operator declaration accompanying the report
controls.risk_prevented: Accepting an unsupported annual emissions report

controls.input_condition: The HSE submits a declaration instead of a verification report
controls.expected_action: Require declarations of MRR compliance, monitoring-plan compliance and absence of material misstatements
controls.risk_prevented: Using an incomplete self-declaration

controls.input_condition: A verifier has returned the report or the operator has prepared its declaration
controls.expected_action: Do not mark the report formally submitted until the operator sends the report and assurance document to the regulator in METS
controls.risk_prevented: Confusing preparation or verifier return with regulatory submission

controls.input_condition: No verified report or declaration-backed report is submitted by 31 March
controls.expected_action: Route to regulator determination, cost recovery and potential civil penalty
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a missing report as zero emissions

controls.input_condition: An HSE uses the declaration route or is selected for compliance checking
controls.expected_action: Retain evidence and allow risk-based regulator audit, with higher-risk HSEs audited more often
controls.risk_prevented: Assuming self-declaration removes regulatory scrutiny

controls.input_condition: Data or evidence supports an HSE annual emissions report
controls.expected_action: Retain relevant data and information for at least 10 years from report submission
controls.risk_prevented: Losing the audit trail before the regulator can review it

controls.input_condition: HSE status depends on primarily serving hospitals
controls.expected_action: Keep records demonstrating continued satisfaction of the hospital-service criterion
controls.risk_prevented: Failing to evidence continued 85% eligibility

controls.input_condition: A verifier assesses whether an HSE site visit may be waived
controls.expected_action: Treat the HSE as category A and require the verifier's written waiver justification in its records
controls.risk_prevented: Applying a stricter or unsupported site-visit category

controls.input_condition: An HSE changed verifier, had no site visit for the preceding two reporting years, or made a significant monitoring-plan modification
controls.expected_action: Require a verifier site visit unless a lawful waiver route applies
controls.risk_prevented: Skipping a mandatory site visit

controls.input_condition: An HSE determines fuel or material activity data under simplified monitoring
controls.expected_action: Allow purchasing records and estimated stock changes where the approved plan supports them
controls.risk_prevented: Rejecting an expressly permitted simplified data method

controls.input_condition: An HSE selects tiers for activity data, factors or measurement-based methods
controls.expected_action: Allow tier 1 as the minimum, but use greater accuracy where it is achievable without additional effort
controls.risk_prevented: Using simplification to block effortless accuracy improvements

controls.input_condition: An HSE uses a technically competent laboratory that lacks EN ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation
controls.expected_action: Require evidence of the laboratory's quality-assurance measures before accepting analytical factors
controls.risk_prevented: Accepting laboratory results without competence controls

controls.input_condition: The HSE relies on exemptions from submitting uncertainty or risk-assessment documents
controls.expected_action: Still require maintained procedures that reduce the risk of errors in reports
controls.risk_prevented: Mistaking a submission exemption for removal of internal controls

controls.input_condition: An HSE uses published UK ETS default factors
controls.expected_action: Use the factors for the relevant scheme year and apply the same factor throughout that year
controls.risk_prevented: Mixing vintages or factors within one annual report

controls.input_condition: The HSE calculates total annual reportable emissions
controls.expected_action: Retain sufficient precision in inputs and round only final annual emissions to a whole number
controls.risk_prevented: Premature rounding that changes the final emissions result

controls.input_condition: A proposed monitoring-plan change is significant
controls.expected_action: Apply to vary the permit through METS before relying on the change, subject to the stated timing rules
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a significant modification as an informal notification

controls.input_condition: A non-significant monitoring-plan change occurs
controls.expected_action: Notify the regulator through METS by 31 December of the year of change
controls.risk_prevented: Allowing minor changes to remain undisclosed

controls.input_condition: Verified or declared reportable emissions are below the annual HSE target
controls.expected_action: Calculate the bankable amount and use it to increase the next scheme year's target within the same allocation period
controls.risk_prevented: Discarding permitted overachievement

controls.input_condition: Banking would raise a small-emitter target above 24,999 tCO2e
controls.expected_action: Cap the increased target at 24,999 tCO2e
controls.risk_prevented: Using banking to cross the small-emitter ceiling

controls.input_condition: The HSE primarily provides services to a hospital
controls.expected_action: Do not apply the 24,999 tCO2e small-emitter banking cap solely on that basis
controls.risk_prevented: Applying the small-emitter cap to the hospital route

controls.input_condition: The scheme-year target is based on estimated emissions
controls.expected_action: Set the bankable amount to zero
controls.risk_prevented: Banking against a forecast rather than measured historic performance

controls.input_condition: An HSE has unused bankable amount at the end of an allocation period
controls.expected_action: Do not carry that amount into the next allocation period
controls.risk_prevented: Transferring overachievement across legally separate periods

controls.input_condition: Reportable emissions exceed the HSE target
controls.expected_action: Calculate the excess-emissions amount as (reportable emissions minus target) multiplied by the scheme-year UK ETS carbon price
controls.risk_prevented: Using the full emissions total rather than only the excess

controls.input_condition: An HSE seeks a higher target after putting a qualifying capacity increase into operation
controls.expected_action: Apply by the end of the scheme year or within three months of operation, whichever is later
controls.risk_prevented: Missing the time window for target adjustment

controls.input_condition: An operator wants to leave HSE status during an allocation period without an eligibility-ending event
controls.expected_action: Reject voluntary cessation of HSE status during that allocation period
controls.risk_prevented: Switching compliance regimes opportunistically

controls.input_condition: Hospital-service eligibility ends or a small emitter exceeds 24,999 tCO2e in a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Notify the regulator by 31 March of the following scheme year
controls.risk_prevented: Delaying status-transition notice

controls.input_condition: The regulator issues a conversion notice ending HSE status
controls.expected_action: Apply GHGE permit conditions from 1 January of the following scheme year and vary the monitoring plan accordingly
controls.risk_prevented: Changing regimes in the wrong year

controls.input_condition: An installation is treated as a USE in the 2026 to 2030 allocation period
controls.expected_action: Require inclusion in the published 2026 to 2030 USE list
controls.risk_prevented: Applying USE treatment to an unlisted installation

controls.input_condition: USE eligibility for 2026 to 2030 is assessed from available baseline years
controls.expected_action: Require reportable emissions of 2,499 tCO2e or below in every applicable baseline year for the installation's start-date cohort
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a single low year as sufficient

controls.input_condition: An installation has USE status
controls.expected_action: Continue monitoring under an up-to-date, fit-for-purpose monitoring plan
controls.risk_prevented: Assuming USE status removes monitoring duties

controls.input_condition: A USE emits more than 2,500 tCO2e in a scheme year
controls.expected_action: Notify the regulator and trigger the applicable status-transition process
controls.risk_prevented: Keeping USE treatment after the agreed threshold is exceeded

controls.input_condition: A USE seeks to leave status voluntarily during an allocation period
controls.expected_action: Reject voluntary cessation during the allocation period
controls.risk_prevented: Opportunistic movement between compliance regimes

controls.input_condition: The applicant is an aircraft operator
controls.expected_action: Do not register it as a USE; apply the separate low-emissions aviation rules
controls.risk_prevented: Applying installation-only USE status to aviation

controls.input_condition: An installation has valid USE status
controls.expected_action: Do not require an HSE or GHGE permit solely for that status, but continue emissions monitoring and threshold notification
controls.risk_prevented: Equating permit exemption with absence of compliance duties
